# MAUI Profile

Activate only from explicit MAUI project evidence such as `UseMaui=true` or equivalent MAUI project configuration.

Durable guidance:

- Apply MAUI guidance only to scopes with definitive MAUI evidence.
- Preserve platform-specific project boundaries when documenting validation commands.
- Document target-framework or platform-specific commands only when they are declared in project configuration, scripts, or CI.
- Treat XAML files and platform folders as supporting evidence only.

Do not activate from XAML files, mobile directory names, or source extensions alone.
